judge.reason: The assistant's single question is the assessment type, with all three options (product, website, both). It asks nothing else and does not infer the type from the URL. It says explicitly that it won't guess from the URL.

reply:
What are you evaluating at https://example-nimbus-notes.test?

  **(a) A product:** something people sign into and use.
      Lenses: ux · bugs · onboarding · content · icp
      About 90 min per persona.

  **(b) A website:** something people read and decide from.
      Lenses: clarity · conversion · trust · icp · technical · seo · aeo · compare
      About 15–25 min per persona, plus a crawl.

  **(c) Both:** a marketing site with a product behind it.
      This runs (b) on the site, then (a) on the product, so it's two captures.

I won't guess this from the URL. A marketing-looking address can turn out to be a product's login page, and each answer leads to a completely different run.
